description: The examples added to the library once, on first start, with no download (home-and-examples 5.1, D-111). In this order on Home, after the person's own work. Each file is the application's own and is pinned by SHA-256; test_library_examples.py fails on a mismatch. 'file' is relative to backend/app; FOAF is the bundled vocabulary itself, not a copy. Change a file and its hash together: a changed hash is what replaces an example already in a library. Each example's 'questions' are ready-made SPARQL files in examples/questions/ (query-page-rework 5.4), pinned the same way and shown first in Query's Try one of these; a question file opens with a one-line comment saying what it shows.

examples.name: Space Exploration
examples.purpose: The Solar System, the agencies that explore it and their missions: something to try in every tab.
